text:
A ball is at rest at the top of a hill. It rolls down the hill. At the bottom of the hill the ball hits a wall
and stops.
Which energy changes occur?
gravitational potential energy → internal energy → kinetic energy
A
gravitational potential energy → kinetic energy → internal energy
B
kinetic energy → gravitational potential energy → internal energy
C
kinetic energy → internal energy → gravitational potential energy
D

options.label: A
options.text: gravitational potential energy → internal energy → kinetic energy

options.label: B
options.text: gravitational potential energy → kinetic energy → internal energy

options.label: C
options.text: kinetic energy → gravitational potential energy → internal energy

options.label: D
options.text: kinetic energy → internal energy → gravitational potential energy
